body: KV-cache reuse in large language model serving is commonly limited to exact prompt prefixes, preventing reuse when the same retrieved document appears after different system prompts, conversation histories, or dynamic metadata. We present KV-Repurpose, an open-source, vLLM-based system for developing and evaluating segment-wise KV-cache reuse beyond exact prefixes. The system combines cache-aware segment scheduling, prompt construction, capacity management, workload generation, and runtime monitoring. Experiments on long-context benchmarks show that naive segment reuse largely preserves output quality for single-document question answering and summarization, while exposing clear limitations in cross-document reasoning. Under a Zipfian RAG-style workload in which 20% of requests share a fixed prefix, KV-Repurpose achieves a substantially higher token-level cache hit rate than prefix caching at the same 30 GB cache capacity, 63.9% versus 3.3%, resulting in lower TTFT. Even with 1 TB of cache capacity, prefix caching reaches only a 17.9% hit rate in this workload. Source code is available under the Apache-2.0 license at https://github.com/taiga333/eval-kv-repurpose.
summaryZh: 该研究提出了一种名为KV-Repurpose的开源系统，基于vLLM，用于开发和评估超越精确前缀的KV-Cache分段复用。该系统通过缓存感知分段调度、提示构建、容量管理、工作负载生成和运行时监控，解决了现有KV-Cache复用局限于精确前缀的问题。在长上下文基准测试中，KV-Repurpose在类似RAG的工作负载下，将缓存命中率从3.3%提高到63.9%，显著降低了首次令牌输出时间（TTFT），即使在TB级缓存容量下也优于传统前缀缓存。
